customManagers.description: The pspdev toolchain image is referenced as a plain string in scripts and workflows, where the docker managers cannot see it. One regex keeps every occurrence on the same monthly release.
Unity, pinned by commit with its tag in a trailing comment in tests/CMakeLists.txt. Renovate bumps the tag and the commit together.
PPSSPP, pinned by commit with its tag in a trailing comment in docker/ppsspp.Dockerfile.

packageRules.description: Group all non-major bumps into one PR.
Toolchain bumps get their own PR: a new GCC or newlib can change codegen on real hardware, so the hardware test tier (docs/development/testing.md) must be run before merging.
PPSSPP bumps get their own PR: a rebuilt emulator can change self-test behaviour independently of our code, and the 15-minute image rebuild should be attributable.
